record.bible_text: The priests<WH03548> the Levites<WH03881>, <FI>and<Fi> all the tribe<WH07626> of Levi<WH03878>, shall have no part<WH02506> nor inheritance<WH05159> with Israel<WH03478>: they shall eat<WH0398><WTH8799> the offerings<WH0801><WH00> of the LORD<WH03068> made by fire<WH0801>, and his inheritance<WH05159>.

The firstfruit<WH07225> <FI>also<Fi> of thy corn<WH01715>, of thy wine<WH08492>, and of thine oil<WH03323>, and the first<WH07225> of the fleece<WH01488> of thy sheep<WH06629>, shalt thou give<WH05414><WTH8799> him.

When thou art come<WH0935><WTH8802> into the land<WH0776> which the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> giveth<WH05414><WTH8802> thee, thou shalt not learn<WH03925><WTH8799> to do<WH06213><WTH8800> after the abominations<WH08441> of those nations<WH01471>.

For all that do<WH06213><WTH8802> these things <FI>are<Fi> an abomination<WH08441> unto the LORD<WH03068>: and because<WH01558> of these abominations<WH08441> the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> doth drive them out<WH03423><WTH8688> from before<WH06440> thee.

For these nations<WH01471>, which thou shalt possess<WH03423><WTH8802>, hearkened<WH08085><WTH8799> unto observers of times<WH06049><WTH8781>, and unto diviners<WH07080><WTH8802>: but as for thee, the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> hath not suffered<WH05414><WTH8804> thee so <FI>to do<Fi> . <RF>possess: or, inherit<Rf><CM>

The LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> will raise up<WH06965><WTH8686> unto thee a Prophet<WH05030> from the midst<WH07130> of thee, of thy brethren<WH0251>, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken<WH08085><WTH8799>;

And if thou say<WH0559><WTH8799> in thine heart<WH03824>, How shall we know<WH03045><WTH8799> the word<WH01697> which the LORD<WH03068> hath not spoken<WH01696><WTH8765>?
